source.subject: test: admit canonical FP8 Z register feed
source.tree_state_at_measurement: The formal validation and screen preceded the source commit timestamp. The measured source/test changes were then committed as 6e3b364 without a content change; the post-commit full CTest used the same unchanged build artifact.
source.interpretation: The exact-C512 Z kernel, launcher, resource query, and harness are test-only. No production selector, runner, public header, checkpoint format, persistent sidecar owner, or Decode path references the candidate.

measured_binary.persistence_note: The mutable build-tree binary is identified here for auditability but is not a checked-in artifact.

environment.claim_scope: one fixed-clock Orin, one isolated exact-C512 linear-attention Z cell, one pinned layer-0 checkpoint tensor, and the current production canonical Z kernel as baseline

checkpoint.read_contract: The harness opens the index and shard read-only, rejects symlinks or shard escape, validates exact dtype/shape/byte ranges and a finite positive scale, then freezes both tensor SHA-256 values before upload.

scope.baseline: the public current-production exact-C512 FP8 whole-chunk Z launcher on canonical row-major weights
scope.candidate: a production-unreachable exact-C512 Z M128 raw-A/raw-B three-slot cp.async kernel with canonical raw-B K16-chunk XOR placement, uint16 fragment gathers, and direct SM87 matrix-B register feed

mechanism.provenance: The candidate transfers the separately admitted QKV P1 canonical raw-B XOR plus uint16-gather register-feed mechanism to the exact-C512 Z shape; it does not import FlashInfer or qwen35-thor code.
mechanism.shared_weight_placement: each aligned row-wise group of four K16 chunks uses the same two-bit XOR key derived from row>>1
mechanism.fragment_gather: uint16 loads gather the swizzled canonical raw-B bytes directly into the matrix-B register-fragment encoding
mechanism.global_traffic_claim: none: no matched NCU or Nsys candidate profile was performed

qkv_p1_isolation.interpretation: The pre-existing QKV P1 selected-function disassembly is unchanged by the independent Z test kernel.

full_ctest.skip_breakdown: one tokenizer plus eleven external-model/performance tests

performance_protocol.payload: read-only pinned checkpoint layer-0 Z weight and scale tensors
performance_protocol.baseline: public production canonical exact-C512 Z launcher
performance_protocol.candidate: test-only canonical raw-B XOR plus uint16-gather register-feed Z launcher
performance_protocol.comparison: aggregate means sum all B1/B2 and C1/C2 CUDA-event pass averages across six rounds in one fixed-clock process

performance.decision: admit the mechanism as a test-only Z cell against the current production canonical Z baseline

projection_only_ceiling.calculation: 0.462653 ms isolated layer-0 saving multiplied by 48 same-shape Z launches
projection_only_ceiling.classification: arithmetic projection from one isolated layer-0 cell, not a production-runner, full-Prefix, TTFT, or end-to-end measurement
projection_only_ceiling.memory_interpretation: The canonical candidate demonstrates this mechanism without an equal-size persistent Z sidecar. Because the code remains test-only, it neither adds nor removes production memory, and it does not change the existing QKV sidecar.

decision.result: admit exact-C512 linear-attention Z canonical raw-B XOR plus uint16-gather register feed as a test-only production-integration candidate
decision.why: The candidate is bit-exact, spill-free, two-CTA/SM, sidecar-free, and clears every 1.15x round gate plus the 1.20x aggregate gate at 1.224345x against the current production Z baseline.
decision.production: unchanged: commit 6e3b364 does not route the candidate from production and supplies no full-P513 or Decode result
decision.next_priority: perform a bounded exact-C512 Z production integration, then require mirrored full-P513 Prefix/TTFT, generated-token and persistent-state exactness, memory/fallback checks, and Decode non-regression before promotion; keep C256 behind this P513 gate

limitations: This is one fixed-clock process and one pinned layer-0 Z tensor, not an independent multi-process absolute-performance distribution.
No production engine invoked the candidate; no Prefix, TTFT, complete-prompt throughput, Decode, serving, power, or energy conclusion follows.
The approximately 22.21-ms 48-layer saving is simple isolated-cell arithmetic and must not be reported as an achieved P513 or end-to-end result.
No matched NCU or Nsys run was performed, so no global-load, L1, L2, DRAM, occupancy-stall, or causal traffic claim is made.
The 1.40625-GiB figure is the equal-size 48-layer candidate sidecar allocation that this canonical mechanism does not require; it is not production memory removed by this test-only commit.
Production QKV and its 2.34375-GiB sidecar, production Z, C256, Decode, MTP policy, FlashInfer policy, buffering, and Prefill/Decode execution remain unchanged.
